D17 — 2026-10-04
chose: D6 as built (2.9). (1) The buffer sits in the per-clone state dir, $XDG_STATE_HOME/sofar/prompts/<clone key>/<session>.jsonl, never in the repo. (2) Ids are P<n> per session. (3) The hook offers the id only for prompts of 100+ chars, also before the session registers. (4) A kept prompt is filed as "--- Operator, <date> ---" plus the prompt through redactProse. (5) One write-back field, brief_append, takes ids or words; the CLI form is {"prompt":"P<n>"}. (6) The off switches are SOFAR_PROMPT_CAPTURE=off and `sofar init --[no-]prompt-capture`.
over: A git-ignored file under .sofar/ (one ignore-rule slip commits a secret forever), offering every prompt's id (about 25 tokens each, even for "continue"), separate brief_keep and brief_append fields (more tool surface, D14), and SOFAR_BRIEF=replace as the ablation name.
because: The state dir is outside the repo by construction, as the diagnostics store is (self-improve D3). Under 100 chars, retyping costs about what the offer line does. A bench session's only prompt lands before registration, so offering after it would never fire there. Measured: user-prompt p50 rises 1.3 ms (2.6%) with capture on (D18 budget 10%).
